Key points
• Prebiotics and probiotics are approaches to modulate the composition and function of the host’s microbiota in ways that
are beneﬁcial to the host.
• Basic science, in-vitro, in-vivo, and observational studies provide clear and robust evidence of host-microbe interactions
which support the rationale for probiotics and prebiotics to enhance health.
• Speciﬁc beneﬁts with speciﬁc pre- and probiotics on particular health outcomes have been well documented.
